Power Plant layouts and yellowprint codes

Published layouts, costs, capacity and prerequisites.

Community imports: not live-tested. Adapted from the supplied Import Code Library, October 30, 2026. Availability counts and compatibility claims describe that research, not a fresh audit. Check prerequisites and the linked author instructions. A published string is not a guarantee that it works in your version. Turbo Exec-dependent scripts are flagged as outdated.

The community wiki publishes five Power Plant layouts with actual import codes, costs, capacities, and prerequisites. Its mid-game layout is explicitly marked outdated.&#x20;

LayoutPublished grid costPower capacityApproximate progression
Starter182,300 yellow3.023MEarly Power Plant
Cheaper plasma3 × 10¹⁸ yellow2.32TAfter Power Plant Floor 2
Mid-game plasma4 × 10²⁴ yellow69.35BAfter Floor 2; outdated
No-Dyson plasma4 × 10²⁴ yellow1.873TPlasma technology progression
Late-game Infinity3 × 10⁴⁸ yellow88.824TMT15 / Electricity Infinity perk

The MT descriptions are approximate, not developer-stated unlock tiers. Costs exclude purchasing technology upgrades and unlocking the relevant building facilities.

The source also reports average production of 132,600 power/sec for Starter and 2.149 × 10¹⁶ power/sec for the late-game layout after reaching maximum capacity. Production for the other three layouts is not specified.&#x20;

How to choose: Use Starter for initial Power Plant development; Cheaper Plasma after unlocking the relevant second-floor technology; No-Dyson if you specifically want a plasma configuration that does not depend on Dyson Sphere bonuses; Late-game Infinity only after meeting its extensive prerequisites.

You can compare and reconstruct layouts using the official Power Grid Designer.
